customManagers.description: The qnsc-eda toolchain container in rtl-ci.yml. The digest is the identity; the moving `main` tag (moved by the qnsc-eda publish job) is what lets Renovate detect a new build and update the digest.

packageRules.description: Toolchain image updates follow the 14-day release-age floor and are never automerged: every RTL job runs in this image.
